name: vivo-shell
description: Shell and file access to the vivo Android phone (droid-server) over Tailscale ssh.
prompt: The vivo_* tools run on the operator's Android phone (Termux), not on this machine. Use vivo_run for shell commands there, vivo_read to read a file, vivo_write to create or replace one. Termux home is /data/data/com.termux/files/home; shared storage is /sdcard. Prefer short, single-purpose commands and check the exit code before assuming success.

config.label: มือถือ vivo (Termux)
config.notes: Termux บน Android: คำสั่ง GNU หลายตัวไม่มี, ใช้ termux-*, am, pm, dumpsys ได้.
